titlePath: EF-REG-014 - Pagination clamps after result-set reduction

payload.elementDescription: The medium-sized 'My Expenses' navigation link in the LEFT sidebar, directly below the selected 'Dashboard' link and above 'New Expense'; it opens the connected employee expense list.

payload.script: return {href: location.href, pager: Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).filter(b=>/page|next|previous/i.test((b.getAttribute('aria-label')||'')+' '+(b.innerText||''))).map(b=>({text:b.innerText,aria:b.getAttribute('aria-label'),disabled:b.disabled})), footer: Array.from(document.body.innerText.matchAll(/Showing[^\n]*|Page \d+ of \d+/g)).map(m=>m[0]), rows: document.querySelectorAll('tbody tr').length}

const b=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).find(x=>x.getAttribute('aria-label')==='Next page' && !x.disabled); if(!b) return {clicked:false, reason:'enabled Next page not found'}; b.click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,700)); return {clicked:true, href:location.href, footer:Array.from(document.body.innerText.matchAll(/Showing[^\n]*|Page \d+ of \d+/g)).map(m=>m[0]), rows:document.querySelectorAll('tbody tr').length, firstRow:document.querySelector('tbody tr')?.innerText||'', pager:Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).filter(x=>/page/i.test(x.getAttribute('aria-label')||'')).map(x=>({aria:x.getAttribute('aria-label'),disabled:x.disabled}))};

payload.elementDescription: The native Status dropdown in the TOP-CENTER filter bar, directly below the 'Status' label and to the LEFT of the Category dropdown; it currently displays 'All statuses'.

The medium-sized Status dropdown in the TOP-CENTER filter card, directly below the 'Status' label and immediately LEFT of the Category dropdown; the closed control currently displays 'All statuses' and has a down-chevron on its right edge.
The medium-sized 'Finance' navigation link in the LEFT sidebar, below the FINANCE heading and beneath the 'Approvals' link; it opens the connected Finance attention table for the pagination check.

payload.script: const b=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).find(x=>x.getAttribute('aria-label')==='Next page' && !x.disabled); if(!b) return {clicked:false, reason:'enabled Next page not found'}; b.click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,700)); return {clicked:true, href:location.href, footer:Array.from(document.body.innerText.matchAll(/Showing[^\n]*|Page \d+ of \d+/g)).map(m=>m[0]), rows:document.querySelectorAll('tbody tr').length, pager:Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).filter(x=>/page/i.test(x.getAttribute('aria-label')||'')).map(x=>({aria:x.getAttribute('aria-label'),disabled:x.disabled})), body:document.body.innerText.slice(-500)};
